notes: Independently verified. (1) E1: stonier's reproduced log (comment 11710175) matches the spec verbatim, including the fuerte binary path '/opt/ros/fuerte/stacks/robot_model/robot_state_publisher/bin/state_publisher'; explanation comment 11710515 matches verbatim. (2) E2: broken-side provider read directly at 87c39d2d — kobuki.urdf.xacro contains '<robot name="kobuki" ...>' with '<xacro:macro name="kobuki">' (line 10) closed at line 192 and no instantiation of <kobuki/>; consumer side read at tag robot_model-1.8.1 (tag -> a30908a22ae1a84c4d6e68a309e0fa089548905f confirmed): joint_state_listener.cpp line 127 'if (!kdl_parser::treeFromParam("robot_description", tree)){' / line 128 'ROS_ERROR("Failed to extract kdl tree from xml robot description");' and urdf_parser.cpp line 158 'ROS_ERROR("No link elements found in urdf file");' — both messages match the log. Not deployment_wiring: no loadable standalone artifact existed and the resolution creates one (new provider artifact), so the provider's interface artifact changed. (3) Fix commit 4ea5ea7f verified: parent 87c39d2d, message 'view_model launcher for kobuki, closes #207', adds kobuki_standalone.urdf.xacro, launch/view_model.launch, rviz/model.rviz; view_model.launch loads '<param name="robot_description" command="$(arg urdf_file)" />' with urdf_file default "$(find xacro)/xacro.py '$(find kobuki_description)/urdf/kobuki_standalone.urdf.xacro'". (4) Loudness loud_documented/activate: ROS_ERROR diagnostics at startup plus roslaunch's process-death and exit — a launch-time diagnostic. (5) Resolution recommended: no run of the viewer with the new launcher is shown in the issue.
